description: Reddit posts and comments where people ask for a tool like yours, look for an alternative to a competitor, compare options or complain. Each lead is tagged with its intent (recommendation_request, alternative_seeking, comparison, pain_point) and the phrase that showed it. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/reddit-lead-finder on your Apify account (about $0.002 per lead plus $0.0001 per post read; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

categories.description: What you sell, as buyers say it, e.g. ["CRM", "invoice software"].

competitors.description: Products whose users you want, e.g. ["HubSpot"].

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 300). Cost scales with this.

name: find_reddit_leads

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Find buying-intent posts on Reddit
